title: Administration: head of department, secretariat, committees (general/administration.json)

title.description: The role. Example: Head of Department

faculty_id.description: Use this when the person is in a faculty list. Then leave out person. Example: smith-john, or mathematics:euler-leo for another department.

person.description: Use this only for people who are not in any faculty list, such as the secretariat. Written per language. Then leave out faculty_id.
